_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Stackable off-chain items (game spec 7 bis, 8). Grinds (reinforce) and gems (change) belong to a rune set and only work on runes of that set. Materials (kind material) are organized by category and tier (1-5) for the crafting to come; they do not drop yet.
